title: Hash The Vault (SHA Two Five Six)
style: industrial techno, 138 bpm, hammer kick four-on-the-floor, distorted modular bass, hash-loop arpeggio cycling sixty-four rounds, metallic clangs on the rotation, vault door reverb, glitch chops on the avalanche, deterministic ride pattern, 336 hz subharmonic under the kick drum, dark concrete warehouse mood
lyrics:
[Intro]
(spoken) One bit changes — the whole digest changes
Avalanche — avalanche — avalanche

[Verse 1]
Five hundred twelve bits in, two fifty-six out
Sixty-four rounds, no room for doubt
Message schedule expand, sigma functions roll
Majority and choice, that's the soul

[Pre-Drop]
Key, opad, ipad — nested twice
HMAC keeps the receipt precise

[Drop]
Hash — the — vault — lock
No collision on the block
Hash — the — vault — sealed
Three-three-six, the receipt is real

[Verse 2]
Merkle root above the leaves
Every transaction the ledger believes
Proof of work in the sweat of the chain
Tamper one bit, the whole tree screams

[Drop]
Hash — the — vault — lock
No collision on the block
Hash — the — vault — sealed
Three-three-six, the receipt is real

[Bridge]
Two to the one twenty-eight — birthday bound
No computer alive will ever come around

[Outro]
Vault sealed — vault signed — vault done
